en_title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Rerelease Includes a Scene Cut From Avengers: Doomsday
cn_title: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》重映版收录一段从《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中删去的场景
opus_summary: 据《纽约时报》报道，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》重映版将在片尾加入一段从《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中删减的戏份，作为后者的宣传。罗莎里奥·道森也将以克莱尔·坦普尔的身份回归。影片重映版定于2026年12月4日上映，《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》则于12月18日上映。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day rerelease includes a scene cut from Avengers: Doomsday , according to a new report.
paragraphs.cn: 据一篇新报道，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》重映版收录了一段从《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中删去的场景。

paragraphs.en: The New York Times published an article on the potential for the release of Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part 3 — dubbed DunesDay by fans — to set box office records, and within it is a tease for the extra footage set to be included in Spider-Man: Brand New Day’s return to theaters.
paragraphs.cn: 《纽约时报》发表了一篇文章，讨论《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》和《沙丘3》上映后可能创下票房纪录的前景，粉丝将这两部影片的上映合称为「DunesDay」。文章还透露了《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》重返影院时将收录的额外片段。

paragraphs.en: According to the NYT, Spider-Man: Brand New Day will have a scene cut from Doomsday added to the end of the movie as a bonus. We don’t know what’s in the scene, but it’s meant to serve as an ad for the upcoming MCU film. Spider-Man: Brand New Day made an eye-watering $2.5 billion at the global box office, so I assume you've seen it. If so, has the promise of a new Avengers: Doomsday scene convinced you to double-dip? Let us know in the comments!
paragraphs.cn: 据《纽约时报》报道，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》将在电影结尾加入一段从《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中删去的场景，作为额外内容。我们不知道这段场景的具体内容，但它旨在为即将上映的漫威电影宇宙影片做宣传。《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》在全球取得了高达25亿美元的票房，所以我猜你已经看过了。如果看过，新增一段《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》场景的消息是否说服你再次买票观看？欢迎在评论中告诉我们！

paragraphs.en: What we know for sure is that Rosario Dawson will return as Claire Temple in the rerelease , marking her long-awaited comeback to the MCU.
paragraphs.cn: 我们可以确定的是，罗莎里奥·道森将在重映版中回归饰演Claire Temple，标志着她终于重返漫威电影宇宙。

paragraphs.en: Warning! Spoilers for Spider-Man: Brand New Day follow.
paragraphs.cn: 警告！以下内容涉及《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》剧透。

paragraphs.en: Last week, Dawson revealed a photo of her in costume for her first Marvel appearance in a decade, standing in nurse scrubs next to Tom Holland's Spider-Man. It's a scene that fans thought they'd never get to see after it was deleted from the final cut of the movie . Now, however, it is being reinstated for the film's extended edition rerelease , entitled Spider-Man: [Brand New] Brand New Day, alongside a handful of other moments previously left on the cutting room floor.
paragraphs.cn: 上周，道森公开了一张自己的定妆照，展示了她十年来首次出演漫威作品的造型：她身穿护士服，站在汤姆·赫兰德饰演的蜘蛛侠身旁。这段场景从电影最终剪辑版中被删除后，粉丝原以为再也看不到了。不过，如今它将与其他几个此前被剪掉的片段一起，重新加入电影的加长重映版《蜘蛛侠: [Brand New] Brand New Day》。

paragraphs.en: It's pretty obvious when this scene will take place, as Dawson's character stands next to Tom Holland's Spider-Man who is wearing a hospital gown and his Spidey mask. Of course, Spider-Man finds himself in hospital towards the end of the movie, and Dawson's return will likely answer fan questions surrounding how the superhero got patched up with no one else discovering his identity. (The answer, surely, is that Dawson takes care of him directly — having been used to keeping numerous superhero identities secret in the past.)
paragraphs.cn: 这段场景发生在什么时候相当明显，因为道森饰演的角色站在汤姆·赫兰德饰演的蜘蛛侠身旁，而后者穿着病号服，戴着蜘蛛侠面罩。当然，蜘蛛侠在电影接近结尾时住进了医院，道森的回归很可能会解答粉丝的疑问：这位超级英雄是如何在没有其他人发现其身份的情况下得到治疗的。（答案肯定是道森直接照顾了他——她过去已经习惯为众多超级英雄保守身份秘密。）

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day returns to theaters on December 4, 2026, now with Rosario Dawson and an Avengers: Doomsday cut scene included. Avengers: Doomsday itself launches on December 18. Today, we got our first look at Magneto vs Doom in a new teaser for Avengers: Doomsday.
paragraphs.cn: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》将于2026年12月4日重返影院，此次加入了罗莎里奥·道森的戏份和一段从《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中删去的场景。《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》则将于12月18日上映。今天，我们在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》的一支新预告中首次看到了Magneto对阵Doom。
